function.description: Returns the raw site ids (`siteIds`) a rule-based compliance (RBC) policy is assigned to (path param `policyId`). The ids are opaque UUIDs and `api_getSites` cannot look a site up by id, so this tool alone cannot tell the user which sites a policy applies to. To answer 'which sites is this policy applied to', use `api_getCompliancePolicySiteScope` instead: it resolves the policy name, the assignments and the site names in one call, handles the Global/all-sites case, and returns ten sites per page. Only use this tool when the caller genuinely needs the raw site ids. Never try to resolve these ids by calling `api_getSites` once per id. Compliance assignments are inherited down the site hierarchy: a policy assigned to a site applies to that site and every site beneath it, so it cannot be unassigned from a child site while the parent assignment remains.
function.name: api_getCompliancePolicyAssignment

siteIds.description: An array of root site IDs linked to the policy.

items.description: The `id` of the policy root site.
